description: This file defines the ReportsScreen widget for a Flutter application, which displays daily and weekly attendance summaries. It includes UI components for selecting dates, fetching data from a provider, and presenting summarized attendance data in responsive cards.

classes.name: ReportsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays attendance reports with options to select specific days or weeks and fetch corresponding summaries.

classes.name: _ReportsScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the logic and UI for ReportsScreen, handling date selection, data fetching, and rendering of report summaries.

classes.name: _Pill
classes.description: A custom stateless widget used to display individual attendance data points with styled labels and values.

methods.name: _mondayOf
methods.description: Calculates and returns the date of Monday for the week of the provided date.

methods.name: _fetchDaily
methods.description: Triggers fetching the daily report data for the selected day via the provider.

methods.name: _fetchWeekly
methods.description: Triggers fetching the weekly report data starting from the selected week start date.

methods.name: _pickDay
methods.description: Opens a date picker dialog for selecting a day to generate the daily report.

methods.name: _pickWeek
methods.description: Opens a date picker dialog for selecting a date, then adjusts to the corresponding Monday to fetch weekly report.

methods.name: _dateKey
methods.description: Generates a string key in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format for a given DateTime, used as a lookup key.
